lessons.title: Observe and listen: Good morning
goals: Use “Ojekoo” appropriately for “Good morning”.
notes: The expression “Ojekoo” is used for “Good morning”. Look at an illustrated exchange. Identify when the phrase is used. Point to the matching picture. Correct tone and pronunciation should be modelled by a qualified speaker of Ga.
activities: Match the phrase with a picture of the correct situation.
lessons.safety: Use polite expressions and respect your partner’s language. Ask a native speaker to model the pronunciation.
scenes: Look at the phrase card for “Good morning”.
Read and point to “Ojekoo” with a qualified speaker.
Match the phrase with a picture of the correct situation.

lessons.title: Identify attitudes and behaviours of a responsible family member
goals: Identify attitudes and behaviours of a responsible family member
notes: Strong families and communities grow through kindness, cooperation, fairness, responsible decisions and respect for others. People can help one another in many ways. Older learners should give a reason and one example from their community.
activities: Role-play helping someone at home or school, then explain why it is helpful.
lessons.safety: Listen respectfully. Never force another learner to participate in a faith practice.
